line.comment: * Task 0.
* Tugs will capture ships even if they cannot dock inside.
* Breakdown Assistance Service
* Expanded 2.2.1: remember and recover the sector reservation across task reloads.
* Always release a claim before beginning a new dispatch cycle or hot-reloading.
* Expanded 2.2: FoF-derived unloading process, with Expanded safeguards.
* Retry unloading before starting another salvage assignment.
* Add-Ons 1.7.5: Tugs use the station's range.
* Only reserve a sector with capturable neutral ships. Search the full sector.
* Claim the sector without a wait between checking and recording the claim.
* Take everything bailed here before moving on.
* Expanded 2.2: Get the nearest bailed ship from the Tug's current position on each sweep.
* Recheck eligibility after the reservation delay and after each capture.
* Search the selected sector, even if the Tug has not yet entered it.
* Sort by physical distance only when in the selected sector.
* Find the nearest valid target. Only one ship is selected per sweep.
* No astronauts.
* Mordan7 If the ship is not capturable by a Player Tug, and we are that, just continue.
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: This flag should be set as soon as the ship has bailed.
* The reservation is already held; retain it throughout this sector's sweeps.
* The target may disappear or movement may fail.
* Recheck both capture restrictions after movement; either can change while travelling.
* Capture.
* This flag is needed to prevent the garbage collector from ordering the tugged ship to dock at the nearest Outpost.
* Clear the flag when the ship starts going home.
* Mordan7 if cheat menu tells us to autorecycle tug targets, set a local on this ship.
* Mordan2 Player owned captured ships by player tug, so we rename and color the captured ship, just as for manual captures in !move.capture.xml
* Mordan4. Change "*Captured" to just "*"
* Do not override a new command issued to the captured ship.
* Resolve every non-docking exit: timeout, lost docking ability, or a new order.
* Leave mayhem_tugged set only while an NPC ship is actually docking or docked.
* The ship is no longer coming to this Tug. Do not override its new order.
* Note: it is possible for this condition to TOCTOU.
* Successfully captured one ship. Discard the old distance sorting.
* One ship was captured. Search again from the Tug's new position.
* Sector is clear. Go home, put down anything docked, and rest.
* Nothing bailed anywhere we can reach.
* Rest for 2-3 minutes.
* The Tug must be in space before its docked ships can undock.
* Do not issue unloading commands if the Tug could not undock.
* Approach home even when already in its sector.
* The Tug must remain in space.
* Do not unload far from home if we reached its sector but failed to approach the station.
* Async unloading is not instantaneous.
* Wait briefly for slots to clear, but keep undocked movement/recovery possible if one ship cannot leave.
* Being in the same sector does not mean we are near home.
* Unload docked ships before returning to the homebase.
* Do not dock the Tug while it still carries captured ships.
* Perform maintenance only after successfully docking.
* $t = [THIS] + ' in ' + [SECTOR] + ' has stopped working.'
* START [NULL]-> call script 'Joubarbe.Lib.Infobox': text=$t icon=29 timeout=0 fadeout=0
* Rebuild rather than delete entries while iterating the claim array.
* Only an explicit live assignment is a reservation. Location alone is not.
* Legacy array entries without this marker are removed during this rebuild.
* The tracked claim, not a reused $sector loop variable, determines what to release.
* Gather all capturable neutral ships; do not limit the search to 99 results.
* Must be an abandoned ship, i.e. owned by Neutral Race.
* Must be a movable ship.
* No spacesuits.
* Existing tug restrictions from Renegades/Add-Ons; check before reserving.
